integrity: The finite-dimensional formula and equality classification are proved by a self-contained planar zonogon perimeter argument. The closest inspected source proves the infinite Rademacher constant \(\pi/2\) and gives a finite sharpness sequence but does not state the exact finite constants. Older vector-balancing formulations remain a residual literature risk.
scientific limitations: The theorem is for complex scalar coefficients and the coordinate Rademacher characters on \(E^n\) for \(n\ge5\). It does not cover arbitrary Sidon subsets, vector-valued coefficients, or other norms. Finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
title: Exact finite Rademacher Sidon constants and extremizers
